meta: Write apology and thank-you letters to customers with AI: a generic apology only makes customers more annoyed.

muc.title: A generic apology
muc.text: Apologies like "sorry for the inconvenience" annoy customers more. They need to see you understand what happened.

muc.title: Three parts of an apology
muc.text: An apology letter has three parts: name the exact mistake, how you're fixing it now, and how you'll prevent it.

muc.title: Thanks with details
muc.text: When thanking regulars, mention a real detail, like what they usually order, instead of a generic thank-you.

muc.title: Keep your shop's voice
muc.text: Paste a few old messages so the chatbot learns your voice, then ask for a formal and a friendly version. Remove customers' names and phone numbers.

muc.title: A three-part apology
muc.text: Describe a time your shop delivered late and ask a chatbot for an apology letter with all three parts.

thu: Describe a time your shop delivered late and ask a chatbot for an apology letter with all three parts.
